text:
emily: Quick sync — final checklist for the ACME on-prem delivery tomorrow. Need discrete acceptance gates: network validation, air-gap image import, GPU SKU parity, and cost burn sanity.

jason: Can we confirm upstream firewall folks signed off on MTU and passthrough? last I heard they were on 1500 not 9000.

maria: They confirmed 1500 yesterday. I'll ask them to enable jumbo for the GPU racks but we need fallback if they can't.

emily: Ok fallback plan = set node MTU to 1500 + tune NIC offload. Documented in runbook step 4.

raj: GPU SKUs — we shipped A10s but ACME expected A100s. Is this an ops mis-comm or negotiated change?

emily: Contract accepted A10 for Phase 1. Need to log perf delta to CS and pricing delta to finance.

nia: For air-gapped import: we have a fresh image bundle and image-hash. Someone needs to run the detached USB import and validate sha256.

jason: I'll do USB import at 0900 local. Command to verify: 
```
sha256sum redwood-airgap-bundle-2026-03-19.tar.gz
```
Compare to hash in delivery ticket.

emily: Include pipeline manifest import too: registry-mirror + offline Helm repo.

sre-bot: Reminder — runbook step 7: apply KMS ACLs after images are imported. See https://intra.redwood/runbooks/airgap for details.

maria: Networking check list for tomorrow (quick): BGP peering A <-> CPE, SNAT for egress, DNS records for control-plane, NTP upstream, and test outbound proxy rules.

raj: Add: validate OC cluster node-to-node bandwidth during GPU stress test. Use stress script: `./tools/gpu-stress --duration 10m --report csv`.

emily: Good. Make sure telemetry bucket ACLs are applied before stress test so logs aren't lost if cluster reboots.

jason: For kernel modules: confirm nvidia-driver 535.x installed and nouveau blacklisted. I saw one node still had 510.

nia: I'll audit all nodes and report any mismatch by 0800. Patch plan if drivers differ: cordon -> drain -> reprovision -> uncordon.

delivery-bot: Delivery checklist updated: images imported, BGP pending, GPU driver audit pending. (ticket RDW-4123)

emily: Customer-networking note: ACME's edge has a packet capture appliance that drops fragmented UDP. Our KV-cache replication can use UDP for fast sync if enabled — disable or switch to TCP.

maria: We'll disable KV fastsync UDP and enable TCP fallback in runtime config. Patch will be trivial: set `runtime.network.kv_fast_sync = "tcp"`.

raj: Cost sanity: running 8 A10s in-phase 1 -> estimate $X/day for reserved infra + egress. Finance needs final figure today to issue invoice.

emily: I'll ping finance after driver audit. Keep a note: if we need A100 migration later, add GPU uplift line item.

customer-success: ACME PM asked for acceptance gates list they can sign. Can we produce minimal 5-point signoff?

emily: Yes — produce 5-point: 1) Network connectivity validated (MTU, BGP, DNS, NTP) 2) Image & checksum import verified 3) GPU driver + firmware parity 4) Monitoring + logging ingestion to telemetry bucket 5) Smoke inference test pass (latency SLO within agreed threshold).

maria: I'll draft a signoff doc and drop in the ticket.

jason: One last ops gotcha — offline mirror certs expire in 7 days, rotate now to avoid daily skews. `./certs/rotate_offline.sh --ttl 365`

emily: Thanks. Plan for tomorrow: 0700 dry-run import, 0900 USB import, 1100 GPU driver audit, 1300 stress + smoke tests, 1500 signoff. Any blockers?

maria: None from infra.

raj: I need a heads-up if we hit node driver mismatch so I can reallocate spare GPU nodes.

nia: Will post audit results in this thread.

customer-success: ACME wants a short runbook excerpt to include in their SOC docs — can we provide a 1-page summary?

emily: Yes i'll author the 1-pager referencing the runbook steps and include contact oncall + escalation.

sre-bot: NOTE: after signoff, schedule a 30-day follow-up to validate autoscaling and cost telemetry.

emily: Great — thanks everyone. I'll update the ticket with times and attach the signoff draft when ready. :thumbsup:
